system_prompt_style.note: Paper only; no prompt mechanism described. Paper mentions reusable prompts but no construction; rule A1 'static low' default applies only to 'we prompt the model with' phrasing, absent here.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Depending on the document property, the executor automatically selects tools to solve the extraction task.
env_context_strategy.note: Document is OCR-parsed into line-entities up front (Sec. 4) and table/reference resolvers retrieve via keyword+embedding; could be argued mixed.

context_compaction.note: Paper only; no history management described. Line-entity format reduces tokens but is input formatting, not compaction.

observation_format.note: Tool result format to executor not specified; resolvers 'return the retrieved relevant information back to the executor'.

tool_call_format.note: Paper says ReAct could be used; call syntax not described.

tool_count.note: Paper names table resolver, reference resolver, vision analysis, customized tools (case study: domain expert knowledge tool, table extraction tool); no definitive default schema count.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: It accepts PDF documents and the target extraction schema in JSON format as inputs and outputs the filled JSON schema after extraction.
edit_primitive.note: Document extraction agent; tool pool listed in Sec. 3 contains no file-editing tool. Paper-only, so confidence low.

tool_schema_source.note: Tool descriptions mentioned but schema origin not described.

protocol_standardization.note: Paper only; no dependency list or registry available to grep.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: the validator interacts with the executor and provides an assessment of the current extraction quality, which will guide the tool selection action in the next iteration.
loop_primitives.note: ReAct stated as possible implementation ('This can be implemented, for example, using the ReAct'). Validator feedback loop = generate/verify/repair.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: The executor is implemented using an LLM, which is responsible for task decomposition, scheduling, and tool calling.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Internally, AID-agent consists of three major components, an executor, a tool pool, and a validator.
multi_agent_topology.note: Validator (rules + LLM-as-judge) treated as reviewer, still single per rule.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Internally, AID-agent consists of three major components, an executor, a tool pool, and a validator.
delegation_mechanism.note: Component list in architecture section has no delegation.

long_term_memory.note: Domain expert knowledge tool loads a static file of field types; static knowledge, not cross-run memory.

self_verification.evidence_quote: Given the target schema and the current extraction, we also use LLM-as- a-judge to generate feedback to indicate possible improvements for the executor.
self_verification.note: Also rule-based schema validation and regex consistency checks (no exact enum value).

retry_policy.note: Iteration with validator feedback is step-level; task-level retries not described.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: Once all fields are extracted (missing fields marked as None), or the agent reaches the predefined maximum iterations, the extraction procedure terminates.
termination_condition.note: 'All fields extracted' mapped to model_declared (closest value); may be a harness check.

cost_controls.note: Selective VLM use limits expense (design choice, not a cost control mechanism in enum).

network_policy.note: Uses Azure Document Intelligence API, but agent action network policy unknown.

eval_hooks.note: No repo; evaluation on 44 proprietary PDFs described in paper.

target_domain.evidence_quote: an LLM- agent specialized in complex document information extraction.

open_source.note: No repository URL given in evidence.

model_agnostic.note: Evaluated with gpt-4o and gpt-4o-mini; Qwen/LLaMA only planned. No client abstraction described.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: Proceedings of the 1st Workshop for Research on Agent Language Models (REALM 2025), pages 80–88

first_release_date.note: No repo/tags; basis is the workshop publication date.
